Third-party components directly inside this directory
======================================================

`fixtures/vendor/` holds two kinds of file: the per-mod Ruby asset trees
(`mod-script-assets/`, `mod-style-assets/`, `mod-script-assets/`, the
bootstrap-scss and bootswatch trees), and files that sit directly here. The
per-mod trees carry their own license file beside their own third-party
bytes, each naming the component, its version, the copyright line its
vendored header states, and the full license text. This file covers what
sits directly in `fixtures/vendor/`.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Rails / ActionView locale strings
----------------------------------------------------------------------

    File:     ./actionview-7.2.3.2-locale-en.yml
    Component: the `en` locale file of the `actionview` gem, Rails 7.2.3.2
    Upstream: https://github.com/rails/rails  (gem `actionview`)

Copyright
---------

**The vendored file states no copyright line.** It is a YAML locale file
opening with `"en":` and a comment about `distance_of_time_in_words()`. The
upstream project is named here from the file's own embedded metadata — the
filename records the gem and version, and the YAML keys are the Rails
ActionView locale tree — rather than from a copyright statement, because the
file carries none. No copyright holder is asserted for these bytes beyond
what upstream publishes at the Rails repository.

License: the MIT License, reproduced in full below. Rails is MIT-licensed;
upstream's copy is at https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/main/MIT-LICENSE.

Why it is vendored
------------------

It is a **test fixture**, not a stylesheet or script source: a byte-copy of
the gem file so a suite can load the locale on a machine that does not have
the gem installed (`tests/card/mod-loader/card-mod-edit-views.test.ts`). It
contributes nothing to the compiled `all-style.css` or `all-script.js`
deployment bundles.

------------------------------------------

MIT is permissive and GPL-compatible, so vendoring these bytes does not
disturb this project's GPL-3.0-or-later scope (see NOTICE at the repository
root).

--------------------------------------------------------------------
The rest of this directory
--------------------------------------------------------------------

`bootstrap-scss/`, `bootswatch/`, `mod-script-assets/`, `mod-style-assets/`
and `mod-script-assets/` each carry their own license file beside their own
third-party bytes. Bootswatch already shipped one
(`bootswatch/LICENSE`). The canonical inventory of every third-party
component in the repository is `NOTICE` at the repository root; this file
covers only what is directly in `fixtures/vendor/`.
